scientific_limitations_and_integrity: Exhaustive exact finite theorem for the ten-vertex Petersen graph, named vertex colours and single-site star-preserving changes only. No general-family extrapolation. All named-state BFS distances are from one explicit program and independently reproduceable; a separate partition-based checker independently corroborates complete state/degree/orbit counts, but not BFS distances. Foundational and neighbouring literature is credited. Complete publication priority and independent external mathematical audit have not been established.
title: A sharp palette threshold for Petersen star-colouring reconfiguration
